tasks.name: Continuous face-presence detection during exam
tasks.description:
[MYG-201] Task What

Run face-detection in-browser on a periodic sample (every 10–15s) during the exam. Log events: face_present, no_face, multiple_faces. Use face-api.js (small model bundle, runs locally — no frames leave the browser).

## Why

The core integrity signal. "Did the candidate stay in front of the screen?" Answers it cheaply without recording video.

## Done when

- [ ] face-api.js loaded once at exam start, models cached
- [ ] Periodic sampler runs at 10–15s interval throughout the exam
- [ ] Three event types recorded with timestamps: face_present, no_face, multiple
